label: preparing
what: A community meal/gathering in the great hall at 18:00 on day 1, with bread; innkeeper is coordinating arrangements with Freight and the builder. Neighbour knows about it and offers to join/help, but evidence for their operational role is weaker. The secretary knows about the scheduled event/appointment, but no evidence she knowingly helped prepare it beyond recording appointments. This was not initially disclosed to the mayor as a community meal; the mayor was told it was an inn matter and later the appointment description revealed it was a community meal.
